messages:
sophia: Quick sync — minimal runtime image landed but init container can't read mounted keystore in staging. Getting permission denied on open().

aj: Error?

sophia: `E init: open /var/run/keystore: permission denied (cap_dac_read_search)`

aj: We stripped CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH when slimming images.

tim: Why is the keystore a file and not a unix socket owned by kms-proxy? Changing to socket + token auth removes need for DAC_READ_SEARCH.

sophia: Long-term yes. Short-term we need a safe patch to avoid breaking prod.

rachel: Is this CSI mounted? Any RBAC changes if we switch to socket auth?

sophia: CSI mount. If we pick socket auth we must grant the proxy SA access to the secret volume the CSI exposes. Small RBAC tweak.

aj: Immediate mitigation: add only DAC_READ_SEARCH to the init container via securityContext.capabilities.add. Avoid re-adding SYS_ADMIN.

tim: Also add seccomp RuntimeDefault to limit syscall exposure.

sophia: I'll patch staging with the minimal capability and seccomp, run 30m smoke.

rachel: Audit requirement: we need to correlate key reads to the calling SA. Does CSI/audit pipeline do that?

aj: CSI events go to kube-audit then to SIEM with kms.access tag, but the open syscall in proxy isn't tied to SA unless proxy annotates requests.

tim: Plan: add opt-in header middleware in kms-proxy to inject `x-kms-principal: system:serviceaccount:{ns}:{sa}` from token. Add structured JSON logs. Roll out proxy change to staging first.

sophia: OK. That satisfies compliance if we log principal + request id.

rachel: Canary strategy for capability patch? Don't blast to all namespaces.

aj: Patch one staging deployment, wait 30m. If green, script propagation to selected namespaces. We'll keep admission webhook to block broad caps (SYS_ADMIN) and allow DAC_READ_SEARCH only for init-keystore name. Feature flag the webhook.

sophia: Tests: applied patch in staging, init succeeded, proxy logs show `x-kms-principal`. Monitoring for 2h.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: prod canary 2026-03-24T09:00Z (notifying on-call).

sophia: Action items: 1) tim: PR for proxy header + structured logs. 2) aj: runbook for rotation and rollback. 3) rachel: coordinate canary window with SRE. 4) tim/rachel: webhook feature-flag.

aj: I'll drop runbook draft by EOD.

tim: Proxy PR tomorrow EOD.

sophia: Thanks all — ping if staging shows anomalies :thumbsup:
